title: Not worth the price.
text:
Not worth the price.. This is a cheap, particle board headboard. It is not worth the price. It came with several dents, scratches and marks on it. (I included some pics of scratches). It's such soft material, you only have to look at it, and it scratches. The instructions were ok. Everything was illustrated correctly. And everything you need to assemble is included. Only, in the past when I've assembled these sorts of things, the pieces are CLEARLY labeled with a sticker 'A' 'B' 'C' and so forth. This headboard had a small ink stamp on the teensy side of the board that was barely legible with 'A' 'B' 'C' on it- see pic. And if you didn't know to look for it, why, you'd be left scratching your head. It wasn't noted in directions, and 1 board wasn't marked at all. I found it by accident. It took me about a hour and I did it myself. I'm a woman, and fairly good at reading directions. It does fit a queen bed appropriately. I did not attach it to metal frame, I just propped it up against wall and ran some 3M tape on wall and backside of headboard. My daughter will be using this in her bedroom.
I'm curious to see how it will hold up. I can only imagine it will be on the burn pile in 2 yrs., but sometimes I get lucky.
